description: Style DNA is a multi-dimensional representation for describing and generating visual languages without requiring named existing styles.

example.name: Lithic Dreams
example.concept: Memory is geological. Forms crystallize from compressed time. Thought has weight and erosion.
example.thesis: All visual elements suggest geological processes: stratification, crystallization, erosion, compression.

dna.form: mixed — organic masses with crystalline fractures
dna.proportion: exaggerated_tall — forms reach upward like stalagmites
dna.line: variable — thick stratification lines, thin crack lines
dna.value: dramatic — deep shadows in crevices, bright highlights on facets
dna.color: limited — slate blues, warm ochres, crystalline whites, deep blacks
dna.edge: lost_and_found — faces dissolve into shadow, edges catch light
dna.material: tactile — rough stone, smooth crystal, powdery sediment
dna.mark: hatch — parallel strata lines, cross-hatch in shadows
dna.light: theatrical — single directional light creating deep shadow
dna.detail: focal — detail concentrated at crystal faces and erosion points
dna.abstraction: semi_abstract — recognizable forms emerge from abstract strata

shape_language.tertiary: fracture lines — angular subdivisions within masses

usage: Select values for each dimension. The combination defines a unique visual language. Cross-medium transfer preserves DNA values while adapting execution to each medium.
